_help: Famous dishes. When something you cook matches one of these, it gets this real name,
counts towards the Signature Dishes collection, and the critic gives a little bonus.
The first match from the top wins, so put more specific dishes above general ones.
arch : what the food engine made (pizza, pie, soup, salad, pastaDish, omelette… see 'food.' names in lang/en.json).
need : ingredients that must be inside. A list inside the list means 'any one of these'.
'op:fry' means it must have been fried at some point; 'arch:caramel' means caramel was used.
not  : ingredients that must NOT be inside.   only: nothing else may be inside.
